findings.issue: Source: 'the sweat that I have sweated, to say nothing of my horses'. Candidate: 'worn out my horses besides' adds a result (worn out) the source does not state.
Source: 'age, the common enemy of mankind'. Candidate: 'age, which makes enemies of us all' changes the sense (age as the common enemy vs. age making enemies).
findings.fix: So the old man instructed them, for he had been in many a fight, and King Agamemnon was glad. “I wish,” he said to him, “that your limbs were as supple and your strength as sure as your judgment. But age, the common enemy of mankind, has laid its hand on you. I wish it had fallen on some other man, and that you were still young.”

findings.issue: Source opens the simile 'As when some mighty wave that thunders on the beach...'. Candidate opens with the imperative 'Picture a mighty wave...', an added address to the reader that turns the simile into an instruction.
findings.fix: As when a mighty wave thunders on the beach after the west wind has whipped it into fury, and has reared its head far out and now comes crashing down on the shore, bowing its arching crest high over the jagged rocks and spewing salt foam in all directions, in just that way the close-packed ranks of the Danaans marched steadily to battle. The chiefs gave orders, each to his own people, but the men said not a word. No one would have thought it possible: huge as the host was, it seemed there was not a tongue among them, so silent were they in their obedience. As they marched, the armor on their bodies glistened in the sun. The noise of the Trojan ranks was different. It was like the sound of many thousand ewes standing in the yards of some rich flock-master, waiting to be milked, and bleating without pause as they answer their lambs. The Trojans had no single speech or language. Their tongues were mixed, and they came from many different places. Ares drove these on, and Athena the others. With them came Panic, Rout, and Strife, whose fury never tires, sister and friend of murderous Ares. She is small at first, but she grows until she lifts her head to heaven while her feet are still on earth. She was the one who went among them and threw down discord, to the increase of sorrow, with an even hand between the two sides.
